reviewer: root GPT-6; bounded Pro adjudication, no paid inference
preserve: Frozen extraction and historical results remain reproducible. Do not silently overwrite D63 or label its engineering QA semantic validation.
permitted_production_products: Canonical advertisement locators, processing states and preserved unknowns
Versioned deterministic text matches with exact normalized-source evidence coordinates
Literal experience-duration candidates, preserving each clause and alternatives instead of inventing one minimum per job
Separate junior, graduate, waiver, task and technology cues with candidate/measurement status

root_rulings.issue: General versus related experience has asymmetric dictionary coverage
root_rulings.evidence: rule_engine._objects assigns general_work only if no tool/domain/task object was found. Generic relevant/related also triggers the task dictionary.
root_rulings.ruling: These categories cannot estimate total accumulated versus specific human capital or their substitution. Within-ad general-and-related is cross-clause cooccurrence under this algorithm; missing general means not recognized as general, not no general experience. Existing comparisons remain algorithm-specific diagnostics. Do not broaden labels while expanding.

root_rulings.issue: Technology mentions and experience-tool dictionaries overlap
root_rulings.ruling: Keep software/AI lexical groups, not employer adoption or technological treatment. Report the mechanical overlap; do not use the group-tool association as independent evidence of skill substitution. Background, use, implementation and development relations need applicant/duty binding; a preceding heading candidate alone does not establish it.

root_rulings.issue: Graduate/waiver markers are not unconditional eligibility
root_rulings.ruling: Keep the 449/11889 result as cooccurrence of algorithmic cues. The denominator is not verified entry-level vacancies. Unknown qualification scope remains unknown. Mentoring junior colleagues does not make the vacancy junior, and employer references to graduate clients are not applicant eligibility.

root_rulings.issue: Independent work and advanced judgment are distinct
root_rulings.ruling: Name existing task_independent_responsibility results independent-work/responsibility wording. Do not call the entire category advanced judgment. Current tasks, previous experience and knowledge requirements remain distinct.

root_rulings.issue: Current descriptions lack verified historical versions
root_rulings.ruling: Created dates define observed advertisement cohorts only. New URL hashes in successive years do not prove time-valid versions for reused URLs. No historic text changes or seniorization trends from this snapshot.

engineering_acceptance_clarification.first5_standardization: Producer formula statically reviewed; public QA checks rate bounds and published delta arithmetic. Common-support weights and cell rates have not been independently recomputed. No identified arithmetic error, but this gate must not be reported as independently verified.
required_repairs: Controller exclusive claim and persisted submission IDs
Exact table key sets and uniqueness in public QA
Honest storage guards and output budget assertion
engineering_acceptance_clarification.semantic_accuracy: Not established by offset/hash/row checks or by a small purposive AI review. No precision/recall percentage claim.

bounded_review.selection: First matches within six broad retrieval buckets from first 8192 evidence rows of one accepted shard. Buckets are NOT exact feature labels; general bucket includes related/unresolved experience, graduate bucket includes education evidence. Not an independent representative validation sample.
findings: Required supervisory years and separately preferred project-management years were correctly retained as separate literal ranges and strengths in two clauses. Do not collapse them into one total job minimum.

A related-experience clause explicitly preferred in wording was recognized as preferred. Another equivalence-of-education-and-experience clause was incorrectly marked unconditional; needs_review was preserved, but scope alone is unsafe.
An education clause containing alternatives among accreditation bodies was marked education_alternative even though those alternatives did not substitute work experience for education.

A competencies subsection inherited the preceding duties heading. Explicit required/preferred clause wording remained usable in the examples, but heading-based applicant/duty binding was not established.

A supervision match under a skills-oriented heading indicates leadership capability language, not by itself an assigned current duty. A separate decision-making clause supports an independent-decision cue without proving job seniority.
Technology evidence retained named generative-AI tool familiarity. It does not establish development or implementation; concatenated qualification clauses prevent confident role/strength binding.

The two graduate retrieval examples are education-degree clauses, NOT false positives of the graduate eligibility flag. They must not be counted as errors of that flag. This review does not certify graduate/no-experience precision.
bounded_review.consequence: Approve auditable lexical/candidate production only. Do not promote conditional/unconditional scope, heading scope, four experience objects or current-duty labels to validated economic variables. Keep unresolved states and original evidence. No new parser cycle or retrospective relabeling of historical D63 tables.

expansion_boundary: Resume the existing bounded 64-shard follow-on chain after engineering repair; preserve completed 16-shard production and await its QA. Eligible product is an evidence-bearing candidate extraction layer. Validated four-type economic requirements, true entry-level classification, advanced judgment and historical effects are not approved production claims. No bulk Pro labeling, API spending or new model substitution.
